messages:
Maria (Partnerships): quick kickoff — we need to finalize partner hero swaps + press microcopy for the marketplace listing. target publish: Mon 2026-04-06 09:00 PST (embargo window). who can own the final microcopy?
Ben (Marketing): I can own microcopy. will share draft today. who owns the hero images/resizing for partners?
Anna (HW Partner): sending our hero pack now. note: we have two variants (light/dark), 1600x600 primary, and a 600x400 fallback. tag with version number pls.
Sasha (Content): need blog post outline + key quotes from partners. Ben, can you drop the PR + blog link in thread?
Ben (Marketing): draft PR here: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/marketplace-pr-v1 (comments open). Blog outline in same doc under /blog. can reviewers please add comments by EOD Thu? :thumbsup:
Carla (Legal): embargo ok but need logo usage signoffs for Partner A & Partner B. Ben, add logo source links and attestations. I need final artifacts by Fri 18:00 PT for legal sign-off.
Ryan (Product): landing page needs event tracking. Dev: add two new postbacks: marketplace_launch and partner_click. also we should A/B the CTA phrasing (Try vs Get started). can we capture impressions -> click conversion?
Maria (Partnerships): Ryan — who on eng owns the tracking?
deploy-bot: scheduled: staging rollout for marketplace listing v1 on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. preview URL: https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/preview-20260402
Ryan (Product): dev-ex team will own tracking. assigning to @devex. Sasha — we need microcopy variants for both CTAs for A/B.
Sasha (Content): will prepare two short CTA options and a 2-line hero subhead per partner. target draft AM Thu.
Maria (Partnerships): checklist (quick):
```
- PR draft (Ben) — review by Thu EOD
- Logo attestations (Ben + Partners) — deliver Fri 18:00 PT (Carla to sign off)
- Hero assets (Anna) — deliver today, tag version
- Staging preview (deploy-bot) — smoke test by Fri
- Tracking events (DevEx) — implement + QA by Fri
- Blog post (Sasha) — draft + partner quotes by Fri
- Legal release (Carla) — final signoff by Fri 18:00 PT
- Embargo lift (Ops) — Mon 2026-04-06 09:00 PST
```
Ben (Marketing): added logo links + partner attestations to the doc. left inline comments for Carla on legal caveats.
Carla (Legal): saw. two quick asks: 1) include partner display names exactly as in signed MSA (Partner A LLC, Partner B Ltd). 2) ensure no product claims about throughput without numbered benchmarks. Ben pls remove any unverified throughput numbers.
Ben (Marketing): noted — removing benchmark lines now.
Anna (HW Partner): confirmed hero pack v1 uploaded to shared drive: https://files.partner.example/hw-heroes/v1 (manifest included). branding contact is josh@partner.example for last-minute swaps.
Sasha (Content): for blog quotes — can partners provide 1-2 short sentences and a headshot? Anna, can josh and Partners send that by Thu EOD?
Anna (HW Partner): yes, will ask josh to push quotes + headshot by Thu.
Ryan (Product): quick ops question — fallback plan if partner assets don't arrive? Maria:
Maria (Partnerships): fallback = 1) use Redwood generic hero with partner badge overlay, 2) delay partner-specific CTA and show universal CTA. please call out in PR doc under "fallbacks".
Ben (Marketing): added the fallback language to PR. also queued a social-friendly 2-line blurb for partner channels.
Carla (Legal): one more legal note — partner logos in footer need to link to partner legal notices (per MSA). Ben, pls add link targets.
deploy-bot: smoke test result: staging preview up, basic rendering ok, one CSS issue on hero breakpoint at 600px. ticket: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/ENG-9999
Ryan (Product): ENG-9999 picked up by frontend. ETA Thu 14:00 PT for fix.
Sasha (Content): FYI — press embargo window: Tue 2026-04-06 09:00 PST (aligned with partner PR windows). Ben pls ensure distribution list aligns (partners + press list).
Ben (Marketing): confirmed distro list updated. added partner comms timeline.
Maria (Partnerships): final callout — onboarding playbook for SI integrators must be attached to listing page or linked from partner hero. Ryan, can we host a short integration checklist on the listing?
Ryan (Product): yes. we can host a 3-step SI quickstart (pdf + code snippets). Sasha, can you draft the 3 bullets?
Sasha (Content): drafting 3-step SI quickstart now. will include code snippet example for API key rotation.
Carla (Legal): approving embargo and process flow pending final assets. once Ben flags ready, I'll stamp release.
Maria (Partnerships): great — plan: Ben flags PR ready Fri 18:15 PT, Carla will reply with legal stamp by 19:00 PT, deploy-bot will schedule final push to prod Mon 06:00 UTC (embargo lift 09:00 PST). any blockers?
Anna (HW Partner): no blockers from our side. josh will ping if any last minute art changes.
Ben (Marketing): will flag in thread when all items done. thanks everyone. :rocket:
Carla (Legal): will watch for Ben's flag.
Maria (Partnerships): thanks team — keeping this thread for day-of coordination and last-minute signoffs.
deploy-bot: note: prod deploy dry-run scheduled Sun 2026-04-05 23:00 UTC.
